lines.en: Low breaths in the night wind.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的凝视，冰冷无情。

lines.en: Thunder Breathing: one step, one crack.

lines.zh: 刀鞘压着腿，我加快了脚步。
lines.en: My sheath taps my leg as I pick up pace.

lines.zh: 剑尖指向天空，电光闪烁。
lines.en: Sword points to sky, lightning flickers.

lines.zh: 凝视着你，仿佛能看到灵魂。
雷之呼吸的型，我记错了一式。
lines.en: I misremembered one Thunder Breathing form.
My thunder breathing broke; my hands shake.

lines.zh: 这不是求人的时候，可我还是喊了。
lines.en: No time to beg, and yet I shout for help.

lines.zh: 握剑的手在抖，雷散了一半。
lines.en: My sword hand shakes; half my lightning is gone.

lines.zh: 雷还没劈完，我的膝盖先软了。
lines.en: The bolt isn't done, but my knees give first.

lines.zh: 雷电环绕，你为何诱惑我？

lines.en: Don't get closer, it's not for you.
Human desires, I'm tired of them.

lines.zh: 你身上的血腥味，像鬼杀队。
lines.en: You smell of blood, like a Demon Slayer.

lines.zh: 我们的剑刃相撞，力量交融！
你逃不掉的，雷电将你束缚！
lines.en: You can't escape, lightning binds you!

lines.zh: 我们之间的战斗，无休无止。

lines.en: In the lightning, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 我们之间的战斗，永远不会结束。

lines.en: A mate's scent, I crave you.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，与她战斗。
同类的呼唤，我无法抗拒。
lines.en: The call of my mate, I can't resist.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，她将是你对手。
lines.en: Find my mate, she'll be your opponent.

lines.zh: 与我同类的战斗，从未停止。
lines.en: The battle with my kind never stops.
Your mate, I won't let go.
The battle with my kind, I crave.

lines.zh: 与我同类的战斗，永不止息。
lines.en: The battle with my kind never ends.
My mate, you can't avoid me.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，露出锋利的牙齿。
皮肤下电闪雷鸣，准备攻击。
lines.en: Electricity crackles under skin, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 翅膀缓缓展开，准备飞行。
lines.en: Wings slowly spread, ready to fly.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的刀，我用脚尖挑起。
lines.en: The fallen sword, I flick up with my toe.
This blade, I have earned it.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸·一之型，起手了。
lines.en: Thunder Breathing, first form: I take my stance.

lines.zh: 眼睛中的电光越来越亮。
鬼杀队的队服，一眼就认出。
lines.en: A Demon Slayer uniform, recognized at once.
You came to die too, did you.
My blade is half a beat faster than yours.
Do not look at me with that pity.
This fight, I have wanted it for a long time.
Aim at enemy, ready to swing sword.

lines.zh: 呼吸一沉，雷声就在刀里。
lines.en: My breath drops, and thunder gathers in the blade.

lines.zh: 我压低重心，等你的破绽。
lines.en: I lower my stance and wait for an opening.

lines.zh: 刀身反光，照见你的手在抖。
lines.en: My blade reflects your trembling hand.

lines.zh: 第一步我会先斩你的刀。
lines.en: First strike goes for your sword.

lines.zh: 队服的下摆，风一吹就露脚。
lines.en: Your uniform hem lifts in the wind, showing your feet.

lines.zh: 我不喊招式，喊了你就躲。
lines.en: I will not call my form; calling it lets you dodge.

lines.zh: 退到墙角，你的刀就挥不开。
lines.en: Backed to a corner, your blade cannot swing.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸，你挡不住第三型。
lines.en: Thunder Breathing; you can't block the third form.
I am holding back thirty percent of this cut.

lines.zh: 挥剑如海浪，斩不断夜色。
lines.en: Swords swing like waves, cutting through the night.

lines.zh: 雷鸣剑下过，鬼影随风散。
剑锋锐如电，鬼魄难逃命。
lines.en: Sword sharp as lightning, ghostly life fades.

lines.zh: 黑影中狂斩，雷电中无踪。
lines.en: Frenzied slashes in the shadows, vanishing in lightning.

lines.zh: 夜色中狂舞剑，雷鸣中生命逝。
lines.en: Dance of the sword in the night, life fades in thunder.

lines.zh: 雷电中剑光闪，鬼魂无处藏。
lines.en: Lightning flashes, sword glints, ghosts vanish.

lines.zh: 剑刃如雷鸣，鬼魂随剑消。
lines.en: Sword blades like thunder, ghosts fade with the strike.

lines.zh: 狂舞剑影间，鬼影皆遁形。
lines.en: Dance of the sword, ghosts vanish in its shadows.

lines.zh: 剑尖刺鬼影，雷声随剑起。
lines.en: Sword tip pierces ghost, thunder accompanies the strike.

lines.zh: 剑斩雷鸣中，鬼魂寂无声。
lines.en: Sword strikes, thunder resounds, ghosts fall silent.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸，壹之型，霹雳一闪！
lines.en: Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash!

lines.zh: 刀光贴着地面，一路犁过来！
lines.en: My blade light plows along the ground toward you!

lines.zh: 雷声在耳后，刀已经过了！
lines.en: Thunder behind your ear, the blade already passed!
Double cut; do not block only the first!

lines.zh: 我踩碎脚下的石板发力！
lines.en: I crush the flagstone underfoot for power!

lines.zh: 斩你的手腕，先废你的刀！
lines.en: I cut your wrist and ruin your sword arm!

lines.zh: 脚步一顿，第二闪就到了！
lines.en: A pause in the step, and the second flash arrives!

lines.zh: 这一刀带电，伤口是焦的！
lines.en: This cut carries lightning; the wound is charred!
At night, the sword spirit returns.
Dark moon, high wind, sword spirits return.
Where lightning and thunder meet, the sword spirit appears.
Sword light flickers in the night.
Sword shadow alone in the thunder.
At night, the sword spirit appears.
In the night, the sword spirit's shadow.
In the lightning, the sword spirit stands alone.

lines.zh: 夜里的主世界，雷声落下。
lines.en: In the night overworld, thunder falls.

lines.zh: 我站在雨里，刀还在鞘中。
lines.en: I stand in the rain, blade still sheathed.

lines.zh: 队服破了一角，我照样来。
lines.en: My uniform is torn at one corner; I come anyway.

lines.zh: 月光照出我的影子，只有一半。
lines.en: Moonlight casts my shadow, and only half of it shows.
Thunder Breathing still lingers on my fingertips.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸也接不住落地。
lines.en: Thunder Breathing won't catch a fall.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，连雷都哑了。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and even my thunder goes mute.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸，还差最后一型。
lines.en: Thunder Breathing — one form still missing.
Thunder Breathing struck my own body.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，雷声留在上面。
lines.en: The ground is gone; the thunder stays above.
